description: This file defines the Informix 9 database driver class and related recordset class for the ADOdb PHP database abstraction library, including methods for handling database-specific features such as SELECT FIRST and NVL functions.

classes.name: ADODB_informix
classes.description: A driver class for Informix 9, extending functionality from ADODB_informix72, including database type and specific SQL behaviors.

classes.name: ADORecordset_informix
classes.description: A recordset class for Informix, extending ADODB_informix72 for handling query result sets.

methods.name: ADODB_informix::IfNull
methods.description: Returns the SQL expression for handling NULL values using NVL, specific to Informix 9 and 10.
